sar.reason: Section 3a & Rule R2: Confirmed unauthorized fraud with exposure of $100.09 USD and multi-card linkage.
sar.narrative: Between 2016-11-11 and 2016-11-12, cardholder C04570 experienced unauthorized activity on card C04570-K1. A total of 1 transaction(s) amounting to $100.09 USD were executed under fraud pattern 'card_not_present_fraud'. The primary flagged transaction 3450629 ($100.09) was initiated through the online channel. The same device profile was also observed across 300 other distinct cards, demonstrating coordinated compromise. The cardholder was contacted for transaction validation and stated: 'Customer states they did not make these purchases and still has the card'. The activity represents a coordinated breach consistent with regulatory typology guidance. The financial institution has blocked card C04570-K1 to mitigate further loss and placed linked accounts under enhanced monitoring.

stop_reason: Customer denial and definitive graph pattern signatures settled the verdict; further steps would not alter the defensive actions.
